prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas. Injury: neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1497; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant later added small details, but the account stayed the same.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was driving in the right-hand lane on a multi-lane road in Katy, Texas, when I signaled and began moving left to change lanes. As I merged, the vehicle in the next lane came alongside me and its side made contact with the side of my car, pushing my vehicle slightly toward the median before I could stop. Both vehicles pulled to the shoulder safely, and I exchanged information with the other driver. Since the incident I have felt stiffness and soreness in my neck and lower back, which I reported to a medical provider. Looking back on what I told the adjuster and the police, I have since remembered a few smaller points about the lane positions and how quickly things happened, but the core of my description has stayed the same from the start. I am the named driver on this policy and I am submitting this statement to support my claim.
